Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study performed two MS experiments: phosphoproteomics on HuCFb cell lysates and an affinity pull-down of ECM-1 binding partners. Following the precedence rules, the affinity-purified material (purified protein or complex) is prioritized over the whole cell lysate used for phosphoproteomics. The material for the pull-down was specifically a purified membrane protein lysate.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis (phosphoproteomics and pull-down MS) specifically focuses on the effect of recombinant ECM-1 protein on human cardiac fibroblasts (HuCFbs). While the study discusses human and mouse heart disease (MI, ICM, DCM), those are analyzed via scRNAseq and immunoblotting, not the mass spectrometry datasets deposited in PRIDE. The primary MS variable is the stimulation with the ligand ECM-1.
